title: Struct Variants
goal: Group named fields inside a single enum variant.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 1 Afternoon: User-Defined Types

sections.text: Enum variants are not limited to single values or tuple fields. A variant can also carry named fields inside curly braces.

sections.caption: Move carries named x and y coordinates.

sections.text: This acts like an inline struct definition attached directly to that variant.
When you read a struct variant in a match, you use curly braces and match the field names.

sections.caption: Braces destructure the named fields x and y.

sections.text: Using parentheses instead of braces on a struct variant triggers compiler error `E0023`.

explanation: Group named fields inside a single enum variant.
